Title: NCF Orders - Enquiries, Issues & Awaiting Goods: Handle with Extra Care
Update:
NCF Orders (Effective Immediately)

The client has told us there are some issues on the NCF account, so we need to handle all NCF enquiries with extra care. Please follow the points below.
 Customer calls on NCF orders if the goods show as "Awaiting" and the customer asks about delivery, tell them:

"Thank you for your patience. Your order is on its way to us, and we'll contact you as soon as it arrives so we can arrange your delivery. We don't have a date yet, but we'll update you as soon as we do."

*Do not give or estimate a delivery date.
*Do not say the goods are already at our warehouse or depot.
*Do not blame NCF or say NCF has given wrong information.
*If the customer says NCF confirmed the goods were sent or collected, still use the wording above and note this on the ticket.

2. Search requests (DDI / warehouse)
*Do not raise a search until at least 72 hours have passed from the date the order was raised.
*Do not raise another search if the warehouse has already confirmed the goods are not received. Add a note to the existing ticket instead.

3. Notes on tickets
*Add a note on the DDI ticket every time a customer calls about an NCF order, including whether they said NCF had confirmed dispatch or collection. We need this to show the client the volume of repeat calls.

4. Escalations
*If a customer is very distressed or keeps calling, escalate to me or the team lead rather than repeating the same answer. Danielle is the account manager for NCF, so I will contact her directly if we need help.

Title: Delivery Date Declined - Post Cut Off/ Pre Cut Off
Update:
Hi Team,

Please make sure to follow the force debrief points before rescheduling a confirmed delivery.

Delivery Date Declined - Post Cut Off/ Pre Cut Off: 

Pre Cut Off (Non-chargeable)
1. Customer declines the next day’s delivery before 3:00 PM UK time.
2. Customer declines after 3:00 PM, but within 3 hours of receiving the delivery time slot (Pre call notification).

Post Cut Off (Chargeable)
1. Customer declines the next day’s delivery after 3:00 PM UK time and more than 3 hours after receiving the delivery time slot (Pre- call notification).

Title: Process Update: Handling Minor Address Change Requests
Update:
Hi Team,

Please note the following process for any case where a customer requests a minor change to the delivery address (for example, a door number or postcode correction where the street address remains the same).

What to do:

1. Do not place the order ON HOLD and do not email the client regarding the change.
2. Escalate the case to the Client Services team so it can be investigated, verified and resolved internally.
3. While the customer is on the call, let them know you will call them back once the case has been investigated with the relevant team, as we are not allowed to amend the address directly.
4. Once the Client Services team has resolved the case, call the customer back and proceed with the booking confirmation.

Please ensure the escalation is clear and accurate, stating that the delivery address is unchanged and only a minor correction is needed, so the case can be resolved quickly without delays.

The aim is to resolve these cases at the earliest opportunity and avoid unnecessary delivery delays. Please follow this process going forward, and reach out to me if you have any questions.
